purpose.domain_detail: A mock/test harness exercising various COBOL statement forms and edge cases including CALL variations, EVALUATE, EXIT SECTION/PARAGRAPH, and MOVE patterns
purpose.summary: MOCKTEST is a test program designed to exercise different mock statement patterns and edge cases in COBOL. It tests EVALUATE blocks, various CALL forms (by content, by value, dynamic CALL), EXIT SECTION/PARAGRAPH, and section/paragraph structure. It appears to be part of a COBOL unit-testing or mock framework.

notable_features: Multiple CALL forms: static, dynamic (CALL VALUE-2), BY CONTENT, BY VALUE
EXIT SECTION and EXIT PARAGRAPH usage
EVALUATE with WHEN OTHER and END-EVALUATE
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Sections and paragraphs mixed without strict separation
verdict.notes: The filename MOCKTEST.CBL and the program comment 'exercise different mock statements and edge cases' confirm this is a test/mock harness. Danish comments ('KALD KTOMHDR, HENT OP') indicate Scandinavian origin. Some referenced data names (ACTION-PARAM, BOOK-PARAM, OUTPUT-PARAM) are not declared in the visible WORKING-STORAGE, suggesting the code may be incomplete or relies on copybooks not shown. No long lines over 72 columns confirms fixed format.
